Roborock's official two-piece mop-cloth page lists the S7 as compatible. Use that product page to check the cloth if you need one; this guide does not link an Amazon mop-cloth card because a same-listing Amazon photo could not be verified.

careTip: A washable filter needs at least 24 hours to air-dry after rinsing. Clear hair from both ends of the roller before replacing it, and remove and wash the VibraRise cloth after mopping. Wear and use can change replacement timing.

questions.question: How often should I replace Roborock S7 filters and brushes?
questions.answer: Roborock recommends replacing the washable filter and main roller every 6–12 months, and the side brush every 3–6 months. Clean the filter and roller every two weeks and the side brush monthly. Replace a part sooner if it is damaged or no longer works properly.

questions.question: Which Roborock S7 mop cloth fits?
questions.answer: Roborock's official two-piece replacement cloth page names the S7. Open the Roborock mop-cloth source below and confirm the product details; this guide does not present an Amazon cloth card without a verified same-listing photo.

questions.question: Does the standard Roborock S7 use dust bags?
questions.answer: No. The standard S7 uses its robot dustbin. The S7+ bundle includes an auto-empty dock; buy dock bags only if you have that compatible dock, and check the dock model separately.

questions.question: Are the linked Roborock S7 replacement parts all genuine?
questions.answer: The washable filters and side brushes are Roborock-branded Amazon listings. The three-roller PELLYDA brush is a third-party replacement. The cards identify each listing's brand and pack; confirm the selected variation before ordering.
